Jovay DApp Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the full-stack dApp generation skill for the Jovay blockchain.
- Guides users from requirements gathering through smart contract generation, frontend creation (Vue 3), deployment, and debugging.
- Provides a structured workflow, including contract templates (ERC20/721), project initialization, and dependency management.
- Includes detailed instructions and examples to streamline building on the Jovay Layer 2 EVM testnet.
